retrieved_spans.title: Password & Authentication Policy
retrieved_spans.text: Accounts are locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts. Self-service unlock is available after 15 minutes via the password portal; otherwise contact the Service Desk.

retrieved_spans.title: Password & Authentication Policy
retrieved_spans.text: 1Password Enterprise is the sanctioned password manager. Storing corporate credentials in browsers, sticky notes, or personal password managers is prohibited.

retrieved_spans.title: Password & Authentication Policy
retrieved_spans.text: Standard accounts rotate passwords annually. Privileged accounts (domain admins, root, DBA) rotate every 90 days.

retrieved_spans.title: Security Incident Reporting Policy
retrieved_spans.text: Suspected security incidents must be reported within 1 hour of discovery to security@helix.example or via the 24/7 SOC hotline at extension 4357 (HELP).

retrieved_spans.title: Security Incident Reporting Policy
retrieved_spans.text: Lost or stolen devices that are confirmed to contain Restricted data are automatically escalated to a SEV-2 incident.

retrieved_spans.title: Security Incident Reporting Policy
retrieved_spans.text: If you suspect a compromise, do NOT power off the device. Disconnect it from the network (unplug Ethernet, disable Wi-Fi) and wait for SOC instructions to preserve forensic evidence.
